description: This file is a comprehensive documentation or design specification for the 'Composite Input HAL Interface'. It outlines the interface definitions, operational behaviors, data flow diagrams, capabilities, configuration, and usage patterns for the composite video input abstraction layer, typically used in embedded or smart TV platforms. The file is structured with sections, diagrams, YAML configuration examples, and detailed explanation suitable for developers implementing or integrating the HAL.
